info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Param1-spec
info.description: The QR Payment Request Management API enables users to manage payment requests associated with QR codes. This endpoint facilitates the deletion of specific QR payment requests using a unique identifier, enhancing operational efficiency in payment processing workflows. Ideal for financial institutions and payment service providers, this API supports scenarios like order cancellations and payment request modifications. By streamlining the removal of outdated or incorrect payment requests, it helps maintain accurate transaction records.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific QR payment request identified by its unique payment request ID. Ensure that the request ID is valid before attempting deletion.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specified QR payment request. This operation requires identification of the payment request being deleted and ensures that the request is handled properly.
